walkthroughs.title: M4/M16 function check
walkthroughs.intro: Checks that the M16/M4 operates properly with the selector in each position; always clear the weapon first, keep it pointed in a safe direction, and stop and turn it in if it malfunctions.

steps.do: Confirm the M16/M4 is clear.
Place selector lever on SAFE.
steps.expect: If the weapon is not cocked, you cannot place the selector on SAFE.

steps.do: Pull charging handle to rear and release.
Pull trigger.
steps.expect: Hammer should not fall.

steps.do: Place selector lever on SEMI.
Pull trigger.
steps.expect: Hammer should fall.

steps.do: Hold trigger to the rear and charge the weapon.
Release the trigger with a slow, smooth motion until the trigger is fully forward.
steps.expect: An audible click should be heard.

steps.do: Pull trigger.
steps.expect: Hammer should fall.

steps.do: Place selector lever on BURST (M16A2, M16A4, and M4 only).
Charge weapon one time.
Squeeze trigger.
steps.expect: Hammer should fall.

steps.do: Hold trigger to the rear.
Charge weapon three times.
Release trigger.
Squeeze trigger.
steps.expect: Hammer should fall.

steps.do: Place the selector switch on AUTO (M16A3 and M4A1 only).
Pull the charging handle to the rear, charging the weapon.
Squeeze the trigger.
steps.expect: Hammer should fall.

steps.do: Hold the trigger to the rear.
Cock the weapon again.
Fully release the trigger, then squeeze it again.
steps.expect: The hammer should not fall. It already fell when the bolt went forward during chambering and locking.

walkthroughs.file: STP 21-1-SMCT - Soldier's Manual of Common Tasks, Warrior Skills Level 1 (Govt Only).pdf
walkthroughs.quote: 1. Confirm the M16/M4 is clear. 2. Check weapon in SEMI firing mode. a. Place selector lever on SAFE.

walkthroughs.title: M240 function check
walkthroughs.intro: Checks the M240 safety and trigger function; the source requires the gun to be cleared in sequence before disassembly, assembly and the function check.

steps.do: Ensure the safety switch is in the F (fire) position.
Lock bolt to the rear; return charging handle/cable to the forward locked position.
Move the safety switch to the S (safe) position.
Attempt to fire the weapon.
steps.expect: The weapon should not fire.

steps.do: Move the safety switch to the F (fire) position.
Pull the trigger and ease the bolt forward.

walkthroughs.para: Chapter 3, Section X, Task 10, performance checklist step 4
walkthroughs.quote: 4. Performed a function check (in sequence). a. Ensured the safety switch was in the F (fire) position. b. Locked bolt to the rear and returned charging handle/cable to the forward locked position.

walkthroughs.title: M2 .50 cal function check
walkthroughs.intro: Checks the M2 safety, single-shot and automatic modes; the source sequence is clear, disassemble, assemble, set headspace and timing, then perform this function check.

steps.do: Move the safety switch to the S (safe) position.
Move the bolt latch release lock to unlocked (single-shot mode).
Pull back on the retractor slide handle and lock the bolt to the rear.
steps.expect: The bolt should lock to the rear.

steps.do: Hold the retractor handle, press the bolt latch release, and ride the bolt forward.
Press down on the trigger.
steps.expect: Weapon should not fire.

steps.do: Move the safety switch to the F (fire) position.
Press down on the trigger.
steps.expect: The weapon should fire.

steps.do: Move the bolt latch release lock to locked (automatic-fire mode).
Pull the retractor slide handle to the rear and hold it.
steps.expect: The bolt should not lock to the rear.

steps.do: Release pressure on the retractor slide handle and ease the bolt forward.
Press the trigger and release the firing pin.

walkthroughs.para: Chapter 3, Section VII, Task 7, performance checklist step 6
walkthroughs.quote: 6. Performed a function check (in sequence). a. Moved the safety switch to the S (safe) position. b. Moved the bolt latch release lock to the unlocked position (single- shot mode).

walkthroughs.title: M2 headspace and timing
walkthroughs.intro: Sets headspace and timing on the M2 HB with the GO/NO GO and FIRE/NO FIRE gages; ensure the gun is clear of ammunition first, because improper headspace and timing can cause injury.

steps.do: Raise top cover all the way up.
Retract bolt to align barrel locking spring lug with 3/8-inch hole; insert barrel.
steps.expect: Ensure no obstructions are in the barrel before installing.

steps.do: Holding bolt in this position, screw the barrel fully into the barrel extension.
With bolt retracted, unscrew barrel two clicks; release handle and let bolt go forward.
steps.expect: Barrel locked with bolt forward should not turn; if it turns, notify field maintenance.

steps.do: In single shot mode, pull bolt to rear with retracting slide handle and hold.
steps.expect: Weapon is charged; firing pin is withdrawn into the bolt.

steps.do: Hold slide handle, push bolt latch release, slowly return bolt forward. Do not fire.
Retract slide handle until barrel extension separates from trunnion block, not over 1/16 inch.
steps.expect: Slack is removed; bolt, breech lock and barrel extension move as one.

steps.do: Keeping 1/16-inch separation, raise extractor; try GO end, then NO GO end, in T-slot.
Read the gage result.
steps.expect: Correct if GO enters to the ring and NO GO does not. Otherwise step 10 or 11.

steps.do: If GO end will not enter: retract bolt, unscrew barrel one click, repeat steps 8-9.
steps.expect: Never exceed seven total clicks out; if so, turn in to field maintenance.

steps.do: If NO GO end enters: retract bolt, screw barrel in one click, repeat steps 8-9.
steps.expect: If fully screwed in and NO GO still enters, do not fire; notify field maintenance.

steps.do: Cock gun; holding handle, depress bolt latch release, slowly return bolt forward. Do not press trigger.
Place trigger block on F (fire) position.
Remove backplate assembly; do not stand directly behind the gun or charge it.
steps.expect: Spring may be under high tension.

steps.do: Screw timing adjustment nut all the way down (to the left).
steps.expect: Nut should not be hard to turn.

steps.do: Reinstall backplate; insert FIRE gage against barrel notches; release handle slowly; depress trigger.
steps.expect: Gun should not fire.

steps.do: Remove FIRE gage and backplate; turn timing nut up (right) one click; reinstall; try to fire.
steps.expect: Repeat this step until the gun fires, then go to step 18.

steps.do: Remove FIRE gage and backplate; turn timing nut two more clicks up (to the right).
steps.expect: Do not turn the timing adjustment nut any more.

steps.do: Reinstall backplate.
Pull retracting slide handle to rear to charge machine gun.
Depress bolt latch release and slowly ease bolt forward with retracting slide handle.
Retract bolt slightly; insert NO FIRE gage against barrel notches; release handle slowly.
Depress trigger.
steps.expect: Gun should not fire. If it fires, timing is early; re-adjust or notify maintenance.

steps.do: Retract bolt; remove NO FIRE gage; insert FIRE gage against barrel notches; release slowly.
Depress trigger.
steps.expect: Gun should fire; timing is complete. If not, timing is late; re-adjust or notify maintenance.

steps.do: Repeat steps 20 through 25 with both FIRE and NO FIRE gages two more times.
Remove FIRE gage.

walkthroughs.para: Appendix D, para D-22 (Headspace and Timing drill)
walkthroughs.quote: Step 1: Raise top cover all the way up. Step 2: Grasp retracting slide handle and retract bolt to align barrel locking spring lug with the 3/8 inch hole in the right side of receiver while inserting barrel.

walkthroughs.title: SINCGARS single-channel (SC) operation
walkthroughs.intro: Prepares SINCGARS for secure single-channel operation and a radio check with a distant station; follow TM 11-5820-890-13&P-1 safety and static-discharge handling procedures.

steps.do: Perform start-up procedures.
Turn FCTN knob to Load (LD).
Put radio into SC mode (1523D: MODE knob to SC; 1523E: MENU to MODE, press CHG).
Select CHAN 1-6, CUE, or MAN (1523D: CHAN knob; 1523E: MENU to CHANNEL, press key).
Press Frequency (FREQ), then Clear (CLR).
Enter frequency.
Press Store (STO).
Repeat steps 4-7 for each channel requiring a frequency.
Change COMSEC mode to Cypher Text (CT) (1523D: COMSEC knob; 1523E: MENU to COMSEC, CHG).
Connect COMSEC fill device to AUD/FILL port.
Press LOAD (0), then STO, then the channel key; repeat for each COMSEC channel.
Turn FCTN knob to Squelch (SQ)/ON.
Enter the net using proper radio procedures IAW ACP-125 SUPP1.
Establish communication with distant end.
steps.expect: Secure radio check in SC mode with the distant station.

walkthroughs.file: STP 21-1-SMCT - Soldier's Manual of Common Tasks, Warrior Skills Level 1 (Govt Only).pdf
walkthroughs.quote: 1. Operate SINCGARS in SC mode. a. Perform start-up procedures. b. Enter the following parameters. (1) Turn FCTN knob to Load (LD). (2) Put radio into SC MODE.

walkthroughs.title: SINCGARS frequency-hop (FH) operation
walkthroughs.intro: Prepares SINCGARS for secure frequency-hopping operation and a radio check with a distant station; follow TM 11-5820-890-13&P-1 safety and static-discharge handling procedures.

steps.do: Perform start-up procedures.
Turn FCTN knob to LD.
Put radio into FH mode (1523D: MODE knob to FH; 1523E: MENU to MODE, press CHG).
Put radio into CT mode (1523D: COMSEC knob to CT; 1523E: MENU to COMSEC, CHG).
Connect COMSEC fill device to AUD/FILL port.
Press LOAD (0), then STO, then the correlating channel key.
Load the HOPSET using the manual for your fill device.
steps.expect: Procedures vary greatly between fill devices.

steps.do: Set date: press TIME, then MENU/CLR, enter current Julian date, press STO.
Set time: press TIME, then MENU/CLR, enter current Zulu/UTC time, press STO.
steps.expect: Time starts counting at STO; deviations of +4 seconds could prevent communication.

steps.do: Turn FCTN knob to SQ/ON.
Conduct a radio check: enter the net and establish communication with distant end.
steps.expect: Secure radio check in FH mode with the distant station.

walkthroughs.file: STP 21-1-SMCT - Soldier's Manual of Common Tasks, Warrior Skills Level 1 (Govt Only).pdf
walkthroughs.quote: 2. Operate SINCGARS in Frequency Hop (FH) mode. a. Perform start-up procedures. b. Execute the FH load procedures. (1) Turn FCTN knob to LD.
